title: AI agent management platform Kindo raised $30M led by Crosspoint and Forgepoint, bringing total funding to $57.6M, and says its revenue grew ~800% YoY in 2026 (Abhinaya Prabhu/Tech Funding News)
summary: Abhinaya Prabhu / Tech Funding News: AI agent management platform Kindo raised $30M led by Crosspoint and Forgepoint, bringing total funding to $57.6M, and says its revenue grew ~800% YoY in 2026 — - Kindo has raised $30M, bringing its total capital raised to $57.6M. — Crosspoint Capital and Forgepoint Capital co-led the $30M round.
